executive_summary: In highlight coverage, our World Cup 2026 prediction market analysis generated substantial earned media across several outlets globally— Coindesk, BeInCrypto, The Block, TokenPost (KR), Cryptoast (FR), Exame (BR) —reporting our $20B onchain volume finding and FIFA's $6M NFT ticket resale data. Our Coldcard hack forensics also drove significant coverage in Bleeping Computer, and Fox Business, among others, detailing $30M stolen in minutes and 25% of funds traced to Canadian holders. Jackie Koven’s insights were also featured in The Banker’s article on dark web marketplaces. In crypto news, Circle's revenue miss dominated Bloomberg and Reuters coverage amid broader market downturn; BlackRock's tokenized money market fund launch in Europe signals institutional adoption momentum; and South Africa's draft cross-border crypto rules (Reuters) reflect emerging market regulatory maturation. In competitor news, Elliptic secured five partnership announcements (LCX, YouHodler) and regulatory guidance content positioning compliance as core infrastructure; Arkham Intelligence pivoted to full decentralization and expanded multi-chain tools on CoinMarketCap; TRM Labs hired a former MAS regulator for APAC expansion; Solidus Labs won Kinetic Markets and Kalshi deals; Merkle Science discussed privacy blockchain transactions.
